main_text.l: Mantuanum, & alios, qui de corruptissimo Ecclesiæ illius statu scripserunt.
Posset idem confirmari ex fœdissimâ lupanarium, quæ Romæ obtinet,
permissione, & quæstu turpissimo, qui inde colligitur per vectigalia quæ
ab ipsis exiguntur, & in thesaurum Ecclesiæ referuntur, licèt Deus vetue-
rit olim in domum Dei inferre mercedem scorti & pretium canis, quia ista
sunt pariter abominationi Jehovæ, Deut. 23. 18. Ut taceam nefandas alias
innumeras, & solo igne expiandas libidines, quæ impunè ibi grassantur,
& laudibus etiam, horresco referens, publicè libris editis extolluntur, de
quibus non silent Scriptores ante citati, & mentio fit in Responsione ad Hi-
stor. Calvinisimi part. 1. c. 10. Posset ulterius & hoc comprobari ex impura
Theologia morali Jesuitarum, quæ ex doctrinis de probabilitate, directione
intentionis, attritione, aliisque id genus principiis tota videtur in id com-
parata, ut extenuentur & excusentur quælibet scelera, & ita pulvilli con-
fuantur[?] sub axillis peccatorum, ut faciliùs genio indulgeant, & in quævis
peccata sedent præcipites, ut prolixè est ostensum in Literis Provinciali-
bus, In Censura Amad. Guimenii & Vernantii, & aliis scriptis, adversus
ipsos editis. Sed quæ dicta sunt sufficere possunt ad ostendendam Rom.
Eccl. doctrinam in variis capitibus pietati & bonis moribus adversari.

quæ vult fidem persuaderi, & non imperari. Et cujus arma non sunt

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "pulvilli con-fuantur" (the word after "con-" is hard to read; the printed form could be "confutentur"). "Calvinisimi" is as printed, possibly a misprint for "Calvinismi". "mis" at the top is a fragment from the previous page, left as printed. Long s is normalised to s throughout, and the printed "compofita" is read as "composita". The reference at the top right is "Quæst. XIV.", printed in the margin beside the first lines. The margin note is "6. Quia ad-versatur li-bertati per tyrannidem", printed in two columns of small type beside paragraph XX.
